ingredients_text:
Flour (wheat) (1 cup) - 200 g
Iodized salt (1/2 teaspoon) - 12 g
Water - as needed to make a dough
preparation_method:
Add iodized salt in flour and knead by adding water till dough becomes soft.
Leave it for 5 to 10 minutes.
Make small round balls of it. Press these balls to make chapaties (round flat bread).
Bake on an iron plate at medium flame.

ingredients_text:
Lentil (daal masur) (1 cup) - 250 g
Ghee/oil (4 tablespoon) - 40 g
Garlic (crushed) (3 cloves) - 3 g
Spices:
  Iodized salt (1 teaspoon) - 4 g
  Red chilli powder (1/2 teaspoon) - 2 g
  Turmeric powder (1/4 teaspoon) - 1 g
  Cumin seeds (1/2 teaspoon) - 2 g
Water (4-5 cups) - 1000-1200 ml
preparation_method:
Soak lentil in 2 cups of water for one hour.
Add all the spices and rest of the water, cook until tender. Mix well with spoon.
Brown garlic in oil. Add cumin seeds to it.
Pour it over the prepared lentil.
Serve hot with rice or chapati.

ingredients_text:
Meat (Beef) - 250 g
Ghee/Oil (5 tablespoon) - 50 g
Potatoes (cut into pieces) (2 medium size) - 200 g
Onion (chopped) (1 medium size) - 100 g
Tomato (chopped) (1 medium size) - 100 g
Garlic (crushed) (5 cloves) - 5 g
Ginger (paste) (1 piece) - 2 g
Coriander leaves (2 teaspoon) - 2 g
Spices:
  Iodized salt (1 teaspoon) - 4 g
  Red chilli powder (1/2 teaspoon) - 2 g
  Coriander powder (1 teaspoon) - 4 g
  Garam masala powder (1/2 teaspoon) - 2 g
Water (5-6 cups) - 1200-1500 ml
preparation_method:
Fry onions, garlic and ginger in oil.
Add meat, tomatoes and all the spices with 2 cups of water.
Cook until meat becomes almost tender.
Add potatoes and remaining water.
Cook till potatoes become tender and gravy thickens.
Sprinkle garam masala and coriander leaves on curry and serve hot.

ingredients_text:
Red kidney beans (2 cups) - 500 g
Onion (chopped) (1 medium size) - 100 g
Garlic (crushed) (5 cloves) - 5 g
Tomatoes (chopped) (2 medium size) - 150 g
Ghee/Oil (4 tablespoon) - 40 g
Spices:
  Coriander leaves (2 teaspoon) - 4 g
  Iodized salt (1 teaspoon) - 4 g
  Red chilli powder (1 teaspoon) - 4 g
  Coriander powder (1 teaspoon) - 4 g
  Baking soda (1 teaspoon) - 4 g
Water (5-6 cups) - 1200-1500 ml
preparation_method:
Soak beans in water with soda for 2 hours.
Boil until beans become tender.
Fry onions and garlic in oil.
Mix tomatoes and all the spices.
Cook until tomatoes become tender.
Mix boiled beans, cook for 5-10 minutes.
Sprinkle coriander leaves and serve hot.

ingredients_text:
For Kofta:
  Minced meat (beef) - 250 g
  Onion (1 medium size) - 100 g
  Chillies green (2 No.) - 15 g
  Ginger (1 piece) - 2 g
  Spices:
    Iodized salt (1/2 teaspoon) - 2 g
    Chilli powder (1/2 teaspoon) - 2 g
    Garam masala (1/2 teaspoon) - 2 g
    Chickpea powder (2 teaspoon) - 8 g
    Poppy seed (powder) (1/2 teaspoon) - 2 g
For curry:
  Ghee/oil (5 tablespoon) - 50 g
  Onion (chopped) (1 medium size) - 100 g
  Tomato (chopped) (1 medium size) - 100 g
  Garlic (crushed) (5 cloves) - 5 g
  Ginger (paste) (1 piece) - 2 g
  Coriander (2 teaspoon) - 2 g
  Spices:
    Iodized salt (1/2 teaspoon) - 2 g
    Red chilli powder (1/2 teaspoon) - 2 g
    Turmeric powder (1/4 teaspoon) - 1 g
    Coriander (1 teaspoon) - 4 g
    Garam masala (1/2 teaspoon) - 2 g
  Water (4-5 cups) - 1000-1200 ml
preparation_method:
Chop all the ingredients of kofta in electric chopper for 4-5 minutes.
Make small meat balls and keep aside.
For curry, fry onions, garlic, ginger in oil.
Add all the spices and tomatoes with 1/2 cup of water.
Cook till onion and tomatoes becomes tender.
Add meat balls and cook for 1/2 an hour.
Sprinkle garam masala and coriander leaves on it, serve hot.

ingredients_text:
Beef - 250 g
Rice (3 cups) - 400 g
Ghee/oil (5 tablespoon) - 50 g
Onion (chopped) (1 medium size) - 100 g
Garlic (crushed) (5 cloves) - 5 g
Ginger (paste) (1 piece) - 2 g
Tomato (chopped) (1 medium) - 100 g
Spices:
  Iodized salt (1 teaspoon) - 4 g
  Red chili powder (1/2 teaspoon) - 2 g
  Garam masla powder (1/2 teaspoon) - 2 g
Water (9-10 cups) - 1500-2000 ml
preparation_method:
Boil meat with water, iodized salt and garlic until meat is nearly tender. Take it out of the soup and set aside.
Brown onions in oil. Add ginger, tomatoes, meat and all the spices. Fry meat well.
Add rice and soup.
Cook until all the water is absorbed and the rice becomes well done.
Serve hot.

ingredients_text:
Minced Meat (Beef) - 500 g
Daal channa (1 cup) - 250 g
Onion (1 medium size) - 100 g
Garlic (8 cloves) - 8 g
Ginger (1 large piece) - 10 g
Ghee/oil (4 tablespoon) - 40 g
Eggs (2 No.) - (amount not given)
Spices:
  Iodized salt (2 teaspoon) - 8 g
  Red chilli powder (1 1/2 teaspoon) - 6 g
  Coriander powder (2 teaspoon) - 8 g
  Garam masala powder (1 teaspoon) - 4 g
Water (4 cups) - 1000 ml
preparation_method:
Boil minced meat, daal channa, onion, ginger, garlic with water and all the spices till meat and daal becomes tender and water dries.
Chop them in electric chopper for 4-5 minutes.
Make small round cakes.
Dip in beaten egg and fry in oil till brown.
Serve hot.

ingredients_text:
Minced meat (beef) - 250 g
Onion (chopped) (2 medium size) - 150 g
Green chillies (chopped) (2 No.) - 20 g
Ghee/oil (4 tablespoon) - 40 g
Eggs (2 No.) - (amount not given)
Spices:
  Iodized salt (1 teaspoon) - 4 g
  Red chilli powder (1 teaspoon) - 4 g
  Coriander powder (1 teaspoon) - 4 g
  Garam masala powder (1/2 teaspoon) - 2 g
preparation_method:
Add all the ingredients in minced meat and mix well.
Make medium size round cakes and fry them well in oil.
Serve hot.

ingredients_text:
Chicken - 500 g
Ghee/oil (10 tablespoon) - 100 g
Onion (chopped) (2 medium size) - 200 g
Tomatoes (chopped) (2 medium size) - 200 g
Garlic (crushed) (10 cloves) - 10 g
Ginger (crushed) (1 piece) - 5 g
Spices:
  Iodized salt (1 teaspoon) - 4 g
  Red chilli powder (1 teaspoon) - 4 g
  Coriander powder (1 teaspoon) - 4 g
  Turmeric powder (1/4 teaspoon) - 1 g
  Garam masala powder (1/2 teaspoon) - 2 g
Water (2 cup) - 500 ml
preparation_method:
Fry chicken pieces in oil and keep aside.
In the same oil fry onions, ginger & garlic.
Add spices and tomatoes. Fry well so it resembles a paste.
Add chicken pieces and cook until chicken is almost tender.
Add water & simmer for 10 minutes.
Add garam masala & coriander leaves and serve hot.

ingredients_text:
Beef (boneless) - 1000 g
Mung daal (1 cup) - 125 g
Masur daal (1 cup) - 125 g
Channa daal (1 cup) - 125 g
Mash daal (1 cup) - 125 g
Wheat grains (crushed) dalia (1 cup) - 125 g
Oat grains (crushed) (1 cup) - 125 g
Rice (1/2 cup) - 50 g
Ghee/oil (8 tablespoon) - 80 g
Onion (chopped) (3 medium size) - 150 g
Tomatoes (chopped) (3 medium size) - 150 g
Garlic (10 cloves) - 10 g
Ginger (crushed) (2 piece) - 10 g
Mint leaves - 8 g
Lemon (2 No) - (amount not given)
Spices:
  Iodized salt (2 teaspoon) - 8 g
  Red chilli powder (1 1/2 teaspoon) - 6 g
  Coriander powder (2 teaspoon) - 8 g
  Turmeric powder (1/2 teaspoon) - 2 g
  Garam masala (1/2 teaspoon) - 4 g
Water (2 cup) - 500 ml
preparation_method:
Boil all daals till tender.
Mash them and keep aside.
Fry 1 onion and garlic in half of oil.
Add meat, tomatoes, rest of the water and all the spices.
Cook till meat become tender.
Add mashed daals and mash again with meat.
Fry rest of the onions in oil.
Pour over prepared haleem.
Garnish with mint leaves and lemon and serve hot.

ingredients_text:
Fish cleaned (cut into pieces) (1 medium) - 500 g
Ghee/Oil (8 tablespoon) - 80 g
Garlic (crushed) (15 cloves) - 15 g
Spices:
  Iodized salt (1 teaspoon) - 4 g
  Red chilli powder (1/2 teaspoon) - 2 g
  Coriander powder (1 teaspoon) - 4 g
  Garam masala (1/2 teaspoon) - 2 g
  Ajwain (1/4 teaspoon) - 1 g
Vinegar (4 tablespoon) - 40 ml
preparation_method:
Iodized salt the fish, let stand for one hour and then wash thoroughly.
Mix all spices with crushed garlic and vinegar.
Add spices to fish and mix well.
Fry in hot oil until brown.
Serve hot.

ingredients_text:
Lamb's leg (1 piece) - 500 g
Iodized salt (3 teaspoon) - 12 g
Ghee/oil (4 tablespoon) - 40 g
preparation_method:
Iodized salt lamb's leg and pierce a rod in it.
Light the coal fire.
Arrange lamb's leg around it.
Rub oil on lamb's leg time to time.
When the meat is well done, take out of the rod and serve hot.

ingredients_text:
Chicken meat - 250 g
Rice (2 cups) - 200 g
Onion (chopped) (1 medium) - 100 g
Tomato (chopped) (1 medium) - 100 g
Garlic (crushed) (5 cloves) - 5 g
Potato (cut into pieces) (1 small) - 80 g
Ghee/oil (5 tablespoon) - 50 g
Spices:
  Iodized salt (1 teaspoon) - 4 g
  Red chilli powder (1/2 teaspoon) - 2 g
  Coriander powder (1 teaspoon) - 4 g
  Turmeric powder (1/4 teaspoon) - 1 g
  Garam masala powder (1 teaspoon) - 4 g
Water (8 cups) - 2000 ml
preparation_method:
Fry onion and garlic in oil.
Add all the spices, meat and tomatoes.
Cook well.
Add two cups of water and potatoes, cook until meat and potatoes becomes tender. Set aside.
Cook rice with water until rice become half done. Strain and set aside.
Mix rice and meat.
Cook over low heat for 30 minutes and serve hot.

ingredients_text:
Semolina (Suji) - 150 g
Ghee (10 tablespoon) - 100 g
Sugar (12 tablespoon) - 120 g
Cardamon (1 teaspoon) - 4 g
Water (2 cups) - 500 ml
preparation_method:
Fry cardamon in ghee.
Add semolina and fry well till it becomes golden brown in colour.
Add sugar and fry well.
Add hot water and let simmer for 15-20 minutes till it is cooked.
Serve hot.

ingredients_text:
Rice (2 cups) - 250 g
Sugar (1 1/2 cups) - 200 g
Ghee/oil (5 tablespoon) - 50 g
Cardamon (1/2 teaspoon) - 2 g
Almonds and Pistachio (5 tablespoon) - 50 g
Orange food Colour - 1 g
Water (4 cups) - 1000 ml
preparation_method:
Boil rice with fruit colour in 8 glasses of water till half done.
Strain rice and set aside.
Fry cardamon in oil. Add sugar and little water.
Add rice and simmer on low flame for 10-15 minutes.
Add almonds and pistachio on top.
Serve hot.

ingredients_text:
Whole milk (2 cups) - 500 ml
Cream (1/2 cup) - 125 g
Sugar (1/2 cup) - 125 g
Rice (1 cup) - 100 g
Cardamon (1/2 teaspoon) - 2 g
Almond and Pistachio (2 tablespoon) - 20 g
Water (2 cups) - 500 ml
preparation_method:
Boil rice in water.
Mash rice and add milk and cream.
Cook till it becomes creamy.
Add sugar and cook well.
Add cardamon, almonds and pistachio.
Chill and serve.

ingredients_text:
Red carrots (shredded) (3-4 No) - 500 g
Sugar (1 cup) - 250 g
Ghee (1 1/2 cup) - 250 g
Milk (4 cups) - 1000 ml
Cardamon (1/2 teaspoon) - 2 g
Almond and Pistachio (2 tablespoon) - 20 g
preparation_method:
Boil carrots with milk, till milk becomes dry and carrots tender.
Add sugar and cook well.
Add ghee and cardamons and cook till mixture leaves ghee.
Add almonds and pistachio and serve hot.

ingredients_text:
Rice - 60 g
Dal Mung - 30 g
Iodized salt (Iodized) - to taste
Fat/Oil (fortified with Vit.A) - 5 g
preparation_method:
Clean and wash rice and dal mung. Soak for 1/2 hour.
Take one cup of water, rice, dal mung and iodized salt in a deep saucepan.
Cook on medium flame for 20-25 minutes, till rice and dal becomes soft.
Mash these and add one teaspoon of hot oil/fat, remove from the flame and serve warm.

ingredients_text:
Rice - 30 g
Milk - 120 ml
Sugar - 5 g
preparation_method:
Clean and wash rice and soak for 1/2 an hour.
Add 1/2 cup of water and rice in a deep sauce pan.
Cook on medium flame for 20-25 minutes till rice becomes soft.
Mash rice with spoon or electric blender.
Mix sugar and milk to it and again cook on medium flame for 10 minutes till it becomes soft and creamy in consistency, serve warm.

ingredients_text:
Wheat flour-suji (Samolina) - 20 g
Milk - 120 ml
Sugar - 5 g
preparation_method:
Fry suji without oil in a deep saucepan, till it becomes brown.
Add milk and sugar to it and cook on medium flame for 10-15 minutes till it becomes soft and creamy in consistency.
Turn off the flame and serve warm.

ingredients_text:
Dalia (Shredded wheat) - 20 g
Milk - 120 ml
Sugar - 5 g
Water - 200 ml
preparation_method:
Thoroughly clean Dalia and then soak for 1/2 an hour.
Add 1 cup of water and dalia in a deep sauce pan.
Cook on low flame for 15-20 minutes till it becomes tender.
Turn off the flame.
Add milk and sugar and serve warm.

ingredients_text:
Banana - 80 g
Milk - 120 ml
Sugar - 5 g
preparation_method:
Mash the peeled banana with spoon, add boiled milk and sugar.
Mix to creamy consistency and serve.

ingredients_text:
Wheat Flour - 30 g
Roasted Channa - 30 g
Fat/Oil - 10 g
Gur, Raw sugar or refined sugar - 30 g
preparation_method:
Fry wheat flour with oil/fat in a deep saucepan till brown.
Grind channa and sugar in a grinder.
Mix these with fried wheat flour and serve.

ingredients_text:
Wheat Flour - 40 g
Groundnuts - 40 g
Gur, Raw sugar or refined sugar - 20 g
preparation_method:
Fry wheat flour in a deep saucepan.
Grind roasted groundnuts and sugar in a grinder.
Mix these with fried wheat flour and serve.

ingredients_text:
Dal Channa - 35 g
Groundnut - 35 g
Gur, Raw sugar or refined sugar - 30 g
preparation_method:
Grind roasted dal channa, roasted groundnut and gur/refined sugar in a grinder.
Mix these and serve.

ingredients_text:
Wheat flour - 30 g
Groundnut - 20 g
Dal Mung - 20 g
Gur, raw sugar or refined sugar - 30 g
preparation_method:
Fry wheat flour in a pan till it becomes brown.
Roast dal mung and groundnuts in a separate sauce pan.
Grind roasted dal mung, groundnuts and sugar in a grinder and mix with the fried wheat flour and serve.
